sentences.text: Shraddha Kapoor -LRB- born 3 March 1987 -RRB- is an Indian actress and singer who is noted for her work in Bollywood films .	Bollywood	Bollywood

The daughter of actor Shakti Kapoor , she began her acting career with a brief role in the 2010 heist film Teen Patti and followed it with her first leading role in the teen drama Luv Ka The End -LRB- 2011 -RRB- .	Shakti Kapoor	Shakti Kapoor	Teen Patti	Teen Patti (film)	Luv Ka The End	Luv Ka The End

Kapoor gained wide recognition for playing a singer in the commercially successful romantic drama Aashiqui 2 -LRB- 2013 -RRB- , for which she received several accolades including a Filmfare nomination for the Best Actress .	Actress	Actress	Aashiqui 2	Aashiqui 2	Filmfare	Filmfare Awards	Best Actress	Filmfare Award for Best Actress

The following year , she portrayed a character based on Ophelia in Vishal Bhardwaj 's critically acclaimed drama Haider -LRB- 2014 -RRB- , an adaptation of William Shakespeare 's tragedy Hamlet .	Ophelia	Ophelia	Vishal Bhardwaj	Vishal Bhardwaj	Haider	Haider (film)	William Shakespeare	William Shakespeare	Hamlet	Hamlet (play)

She established herself as one of the high-profile actresses in Bollywood with starring roles in the romantic thriller Ek Villain -LRB- 2014 -RRB- , the dance drama ABCD 2 -LRB- 2015 -RRB- , the action drama Baaghi -LRB- 2016 -RRB- and the romantic drama Half Girlfriend -LRB- 2017 -RRB- , all of which rank among her biggest commercial successes .	Baaghi	Baaghi (2016 film)	Bollywood	Bollywood	Ek Villain	Ek Villain	ABCD 2	ABCD 2	Half Girlfriend	Half Girlfriend (film)
In addition to acting in films , Kapoor has sung several of her film songs .
She is the celebrity endorser for several brands and products , and in 2015 , she launched her own line of clothing .
She participates in stage shows and concerts .
Kapoor features in listings of the most attractive and popular celebrities in India .
